text:
nina: Quick flag — two pilot customers asking to move tenant SSO into public v1. Sales pushing. We need a fast scope call.

raj: Engineering: full SSO + provisioning = ~3w dev + 1w security review. Touches auth, routing, and audit exports. Risky for current v1 surface.

emma: Product: Recommend keep v1 narrow (core inference + basic tenant routing) and offer SSO as paid pilot (SOW). That avoids slipping milestone.

peter: Ops: We can do manual onboarding for 1-2 pilots short-term but need an ops runbook and clear SLA in SOW.

nina: Proposal: three paths — A) Keep v1 tight, pilot SOW for early SSO; B) Delay v1 ~2w and fold SSO; C) Ship experimental SSO behind feature-flag in v1 with limited audit. Thoughts?

raj: I prefer A or C. C adds immediate compliance work and a rollback plan. A isolates schedule risk.

emma: UX can ship placeholder screens quickly for pilots. Docs + migration note should accompany any pilot flag.

ops-bot: Meeting created: "SSO pilot decision" 2026-03-26 10:00 PT.

nina: Quick vote: :thumbsup: for pilot-SOW + keep v1; :thumbsdown: for fold SSO into v1 and delay. React now.

raj: :thumbsup:

emma: :thumbsup:

peter: :thumbsup: (ops ok for short-term support)

nina: Consensus -> keep v1. Action items: raj = RFC + estimate by EOD tomorrow; emma = placeholder UX + migration doc by Wed; peter = ops runbook by Fri. I'll update roadmap after estimates. Thanks!
